source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        lo = max(0, center - r)
        hi = min(n - 1, center + r)
        for c in range(n):
            if r <= center and abs(c - center) == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif lo <= c <= hi and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
            elif r > center and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
